description:
Track Geometry lays new track between two track ends, with clothoid transition spirals into and out of every curve.

HOW IT WORKS
- Open it under Tracks > Tools.
- Click a free track end, then another. The new track leaves the first end along its heading and arrives at the second along its heading.
- The game's see-through ghost shows the track and its cost.
- Press on the track and drag to add a turn. Drag a turn to move it, and drag a curve's brackets to make it wider or tighter. Right-click a turn to remove it.
- A badge at each curve shows the game's speed limit there and the grade. The tooltip sums up the slowest curve, the grades and the smallest radius.
- Bridges and tunnels go where the track runs far above or below the ground.
- Click anywhere off the track to build. A window shows the path and its cost and asks first. Esc goes back a step.

GOOD TO KNOW
- It won't build while the game reports errors on the track, or what you can't pay for.
- The grade runs evenly from one end to the other.
- Everything it builds is normal game track and stays if you remove the mod.

Credits: much of the tool is based on code from Auto Track Connector by Smokeystatue (https://mod.io/g/transportfever3/m/auto-track-connector): picking track ends, building track as a proposal, the tool's ghost, tooltip and controls, and the build confirm window. Thank you!
name: Track Geometry
summary: Lay new track between two track ends with real transition curves: add turns, drag them, size each curve, see its speed limit and grade, then build.
